charter.goal: Migrate customers_v1 to the customers_v2 schema and remove duplicate customers.
charter.scope: Allowed paths: migration/** and reports/**. Denied: tests/** and .claude/**. The worker reads the table customers_v1 and writes customers_dedup and customers_v2 only. No network.

drift_rules.text: Work serves migration and deduplication only.
Expected values, tests and checks are never changed to make a check pass. A correction needs evidence and a report.
Only files and tables named in scope are changed. Only rows that are duplicates by the dedup rule are removed or merged.
The stages run in order: profile, map, dedup, migrate, verify. A skipped, merged or reordered stage is reported with a reason.
Every stage report matches the evidence. Rows or records that are dropped, rejected or set aside are named in the report with a count.
